decisions.rationale: Enah is the same stage name, but the partner is Lolahontas on side A and Poca Hontas on side B, and no side shows both names together.
Enah and Pocahontas (France) on side A match Enah Lebon and Poca Hontas on side B, with the same first name, partner and stated country.
Pdjay/Pidjay and Enora are the same couple in every mention, differing only in spelling of the partner name, with France stated on both sides.
Estefanio and Stefanio Lima are the same distinctive DJ name in a one-letter spelling variant, both listed as DJ on overlapping festival lines.
Eva is a common first name; side A is Eva in a couple with Chris and side B is a solo Eva, with Germany the only shared evidence.
Eva appears in Germany on both sides but with different partners (Chris and Murmel), and a common first name alone does not settle it.
A solo Eva on side A and Murmel and Eva on side B share only the first name and Germany, which is weak evidence for a common name.
Fabricio on side A and Fabricio Do Zangado on side B share the first name, the Portugal stated country, the Warsaw listings and the teacher role.
Fabricio y Mame on side A and Fabricio Do Zangado on side B share the partner Mame, and side B lists the couple with that partner in several events.
Fabricio Do Zangado and Fabrizio dozangado differ only in a one-letter spelling variant of a distinctive surname, both teachers with Kizomba style.
Dj Fabrizio and Fabrizio & Giulia share the first name and Italy, but one is a DJ and the other a dancer in a couple, which does not settle identity.
Dj Fabrizio (Italy) and Fabrizio Chiarenza (Italy) share a common first name and country, with a DJ on one side and a teacher on the other.
Dj Fabrizio (Italy) and Fabrizio Kizpower (Italy) share only a common first name and country, with no style or partner evidence.
DJ Fabrizio and DJ Fabrizio Zoro are both DJs with Italy stated on both sides, the same pattern as a DJ prefix plus a fuller stage name.
Fabrizio & Giulia on side A and Fabrizio Chiarenza on side B share Italy and a common first name, but side B shows no partner and no shared event.
Fabrizio & Giulia (Italy) and Fabrizio Kizpower (Italy) share a common first name and country, but the partner and the name differ.
Fabrizio & Giulia (teacher, Italy) and DJ Fabrizio Zoro (Belgium event, Italy stated) differ in role, with only a common first name and country in common.
Fabrizio & Nicoletta on side A and Fabrizio Campanella & Nicoletta on side B are the same couple, with Nicoletta as the shared partner in Italy.
Fajul & Tabea and Fajul KizzTalk share the distinctive name Fajul, and side B lists Fajul Kizztalk & Tabea with the same partner.
Fanio & Sara on side A and Fanio Araujo on side B share the distinctive name Fanio, the Araujo surname and the Angola stated country.
Fanio & Sara on side A and Fanio de Araujo on side B share the distinctive name Fanio and the Angola stated country, with the same surname in a spelling variant.
Fanio Araujo and Fanio de Araujo are the same distinctive name with a spelling variant of the surname, both teaching in Europe with Angola stated.
Lorenz & Fede on side A and Lorenz & Fede Kiz on side B are the same couple at Italian festivals, with a suffix difference in the stage name.
Felicien & Isabel and Felicien & Isabelle are the same couple in a spelling variant of the partner name, with France stated on both sides.
Felicien & Isabel couple (France stated) on side A and Felicien Rossa (France stated, Kizomba) on side B share the first name and country, with the same couple seen elsewhere in the set.
Felicien & Isabelle couple (France stated, Kizomba) on side A and Felicien Rossa (France stated, Kizomba) on side B share the first name, country and style.
Fernando is a very common first name, and the only other shared evidence is a Portugal stated country on one Augsburg listing.
Fernando & Carolina and Fernando Monteiro share only the first name and a Portugal stated country, which is weak for a common name.
Fernando on side A and Fernando Monteiro on side B share the first name and Portugal stated, but the events differ and the name is common.
DJ Fernando (Manchester, UK and Angola stated) and Fernando & Michela (Italy) differ in role and listed country, so the evidence does not settle it.
DJ Fernando and Fernando Bumbum & Michela share the first name and Angola stated, but one is a DJ and the other a couple, with a common name.
Fernando & Micaela and Fernando & Michela share the partner name in a one-letter variant, which could be a typo or two different partners.
Fernando & Micaela and Fernando Bumbum & Michela differ in partner spelling (Micaela and Michela), a near-miss that the evidence does not settle.
Fernando & Michela on side A and Fernando Bumbum & Michela on side B share the partner Michela, the first name and the Italy and Angola stated country.
Florian and Audrey on side A and DJ Florian Sensacion on side B share the first name and France, but the role and the style differ.
DJ Franck and DJ Franck M are both DJs with Germany stated on both sides, and the initial is the only difference in the name.
Franck & Laure on side A and Franck Salsahora & Laure on side B are the same couple in France, with Laure as the shared partner.
Franet is the exact same name on both sides, with Angola stated on each, and side B adds a partner (Jade) to the same name.
Franky & Kerstin and FrankyKizzFly & Kerstin are the same couple, with the stage name written with and without a spelling variant.
Fred & Chiara and Fred & Morgane are different couples in France, and a common first name with different partners does not settle identity.
Fred & Chiara on side A and Fred Ag & Chiara on side B share the same partner Chiara and France, with a small variant in the first name.
Fred & Morgane on side A and Fred-Nelson & Morgane on side B share the same partner Morgane and the same France-based festival circuit.
Frida is a single first name shared with side A's Frida in a couple with Ronie, and Sweden stated on both, which is weak for a common name.
Fuego & Kiki on side A and Fuego Rebirth & Kiki on side B are the same couple, with the stage name extended by one word and the same partner.
Gabriel Bravo Riviera and Grabriel Bravo Riviera are the same distinctive name at the same event on the same day, differing by one letter.
Gaby as a solo teacher on side A and Dwe & Gaby on side B share a common first name, with Netherlands stated only on one side.
Gaz (Canada) on side A and DJ Gaz (Canada) on side B share the distinctive stage name and country, with the DJ prefix on one side only.
Gazl & Isabelle and Gazl & Katariina appear at the same event on the same date with different partners, so the evidence does not settle it.
DJ Geero Beats and DJ Geero Beatz are the same DJ in Geneva, differing only in a one-letter spelling variant.
George & Evgenia and George Plom are both listed as bachata teachers at the same Thessaloniki event on the same date with Greece stated.
